record.cause_confidence: A concurrent fork temporarily retaining a writer descriptor until exec/exit is plausible, not established by the retained log. The test incorrectly assumes its own last local producer drop proves that every process has closed every writer.
record.observed_failure: The retained 1.88 feature matrix log reports the assertion requiring HUP immediately after producer drop; 976 library tests passed and this one failed.
record.production: run_capture accepts readable stdout without HUP and keeps draining/polling until read returns EOF. poll_zone_fds deliberately does not reject stdout HUP. No corresponding production defect was found.
recommended_test_correction: Wait for actual output HUP with an empty requested event mask under the existing deadline, keeping blocked input OUT interest. HUP is reported regardless of requested mask; buffered IN cannot spin the wait.
After observing HUP, read_to_end must preserve and decode every buffered response byte.
For the final input ERR check, use a fresh quiet output whose producer remains alive, and wait for Unavailable under the same deadline. This avoids old output EOF/HUP repeatedly waking the loop.

Optionally retain a producer clone explicitly, drop the original and verify IN without HUP, then drop the clone before bounded HUP waiting. This tests the assumption deterministically without sleeps or quota changes.
